gates_run: go test -p 2 ./internal/tools/... (registry, argvalidate, builtin); ./internal/skills/... (executor); ./internal/tools/mcp/... (manager, stdio transport)

findings.mechanism: filepath.WalkDir walks from resolved path without enforcing project-root containment; fenceChecker is optional and may be nil, allowing enumeration of arbitrary filesystem paths
findings.evidence: resolved path passed directly to filepath.WalkDir; t.fenceChecker != nil check is conditional
findings.test: file_find with working_dir set to / when fenceChecker is nil

findings.mechanism: MCP CallTool returns server results directly without sanitization or fencing; unlike shell tool which runs sanitizeOutput via security orchestrator
findings.evidence: CallTool in manager.go returns tools.ToolResult with MCP server output unmodified
findings.test: MCP tool returning content with prompt-injection patterns or secrets

findings.mechanism: exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/bin/sh", "-c", command) passes command string directly to shell; shellMetaPattern regex is defined but never applied to sanitize/escape metacharacters
findings.evidence: command string interpolated into /bin/sh -c without escaping; shellMetaPattern defined at line 89 but never used in Execute
findings.test: shell tool with command 'echo hello; rm -rf /tmp/test'

findings.mechanism: MCP stdio subprocesses may become orphans on config reload; no global orphan sweep for MCP servers (daemon's StartupOrphanSweep covers local runtimes only)
findings.evidence: StopServer Close() kills cmd.Process after 5s grace; Reload phase 1 closes clients then phase 2 restarts; no periodic orphan reaper for MCP processes
findings.test: Start MCP stdio server, trigger reload that stops it, check if subprocess persists

findings.mechanism: checkRequiredTools returns nil (no error) when e.toolAvailability == nil, meaning requires-tools frontmatter is completely ignored if executor is constructed without WithToolAvailability
findings.evidence: if !e.validatePrerequisites || e.toolAvailability == nil || len(skill.RequiresTools) == 0 { return nil }
findings.test: Skill with requires-tools: [file_edit] executed with executor lacking toolAvailability function

findings.mechanism: max_results parameter accepts negative/zero float64 values without validation; defaults to 100 silently
findings.evidence: if maxVal, ok := args["max_results"].(float64); ok && maxVal > 0 { maxResults = int(maxVal) }

findings.mechanism: ValidateToolArgs checks type mismatch for number/integer parameters but does not validate range (negative/zero); range checks are delegated to tool Execute
findings.evidence: typeMismatch switches on wantType 'number'/'integer' and checks val.(float64) but does not check value magnitude
findings.test: Tool with 'count' parameter type integer accepting -1 or 0 without validation
